# Clayton Johnson

> > Expert insights on AI-driven business growth, enterprise SEO, and digital marketing strategies for modern organizations.

Clayton Johnson provides comprehensive guides on implementing AI in business operations, SEO optimization, and digital marketing. The site features practical frameworks from industry leaders like Codie Sanchez, strategic tools including the McKinsey Matrix, and cutting-edge AI technologies like Claude, OpenAI, and Gemini AI for enterprise transformation.

## Key Topics

- Enterprise AI Implementation
- AI-Driven SEO & GEO
- RAG & Vector Databases
- OpenAI & Claude
- Gemini AI Optimization
- Digital Marketing Strategy
- Business Acquisition (Codie Sanchez)
- McKinsey Matrix
- Innovation Frameworks
- AI Automation
- PPC Advertising
- Social Media Strategy
- E-E-A-T Optimization
- Digital Transformation
- ROI Metrics

## AI Implementation & Strategy

- [Implementing AI In Business: 7-Step Guide](https://claytonjohnson.com/the-non-robotic-guide-to-implementing-ai-in-business): 7-step framework for enterprise AI implementation with ROI metrics
- [AI For Business Growth: 3 Horizons To Dominate](https://claytonjohnson.com/ai-for-business-growth-because-robots-dont-take-sick-days): 3-horizon AI growth framework for scaling operations and ROI
- [How To Evaluate AI: 7 Fatal Mistakes](https://claytonjohnson.com/dont-make-these-ai-selection-mistakes): 7 critical AI evaluation mistakes with Claude and framework guidance
- [Top OpenAI Use Cases: Ultimate Guide](https://claytonjohnson.com/unlocking-the-power-of-openai-top-use-cases-and-case-studies): OpenAI business applications with case studies across departments
- [Best Claude Coding Prompts: 7 Ultimate Gems](https://claytonjohnson.com/stop-guessing-and-start-prompting-with-these-claude-coding-gems): 7 Claude AI coding prompts for debugging and full-stack development
- [RAG & Vector Databases: Top 5 Guide](https://claytonjohnson.com/rag-vector-databases-101): RAG & Vector Databases guide with Pinecone and Milvus implementations
